title: People register
description: The person register (#212): a scope-level entity table, authored and reviewed, never extracted. Each entry compiles to a Person node `person:<slug>`. `principal` is the OIDC issuer + subject the entry binds to, the one identity every host trusts; `identities` lists the host-side identities that resolve to it (a Cloudflare Access email, a federation or context consumer credential actor, the issuer + subject another identity provider asserts). An identity bound to two principals is refused, never guessed at. Identity across brains is an equivalence edge in app/equivalences.json, never a merge.

issuer.description: The OIDC `iss` claim, exactly as the identity provider asserts it.

consumers.description: Federation or context-service consumer credential actors.

oidc.description: Issuer + subject pairs other identity providers assert (Cognito behind an ALB, IAP, Entra ID).
